name: kit-themes
description: Three original themes for the Claude desktop and mobile apps: Paper (warm light), High Contrast (WCAG AAA) and Night (low blue light). Auto follows light or dark mode, so installing it already shows a theme; /themes picks another or turns it off.

theme.title: Theme to start with
theme.description: auto: Paper in light mode, Night in dark mode. paper, contrast, night: always that theme. off: no theme. A choice made with /themes is remembered and wins over this.

language.title: Language of /themes
language.description: auto: Vietnamese when Claude Code's own language setting is Vietnamese, English otherwise (looked up once at session start). en: always English. vi: always Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt).
